hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible, making it difficult for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway safely.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway.

hazards.name: Undefined Roadway Space
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide road may lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway surface.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk is very narrow, making it difficult for two people to pass or for someone with a mobility device to navigate comfortably.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the base of the red brick building

hazards.name: Physical Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly at the edge of the narrow sidewalk, further reducing the effective clear width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks to provide safe and designated crossing points across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures such as speed humps or curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds in this industrial corridor.

interventions.title: Install Mid-block Crossing with Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Provide a safe, marked location for pedestrians to cross while shortening the crossing distance and improving visibility.

interventions.title: Add Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve safety and the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections to facilitate safe pedestrian movement across the roadway.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the curb edge or underground the utilities to ensure a clear, accessible through-zone for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase separation and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions to narrow the crossing distance and prevent trucks from parking too close to potential crossing points.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Narrowing
interventions.description: Add painted lane lines to define travel lanes and narrow the perceived width of the road to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians in this industrial area.

interventions.title: Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Delineate a clear pedestrian path and separate it from vehicle loading zones using paint or bollards.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian crossing warning signs to define safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Paint lane lines to narrow the perceived roadway and install speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this industrial/residential transition zone.

interventions.title: Dedicated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Implement clearly marked and enforced commercial loading zones to prevent delivery vehicles from obstructing walkways or sightlines.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure clear sightlines at nearby intersections by removing parking and obstructions near corners to mitigate the risk of large vehicles blocking views.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion and Widening
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side and widen the existing left-side sidewalk to accommodate utility poles without blocking the path.

interventions.title: Designated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Implement clearly marked loading zones and 'No Parking' areas near potential crossing points to maintain sightlines.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install a marked midblock crossing with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility between parked trucks.

interventions.title: Designated Pedestrian Walkway
interventions.description: Implement a clearly marked or physically separated pedestrian path along the building frontage to provide a safe route through the industrial zone.

interventions.title: Warning Signage and Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Install 'Watch for Pedestrians' signs and paint 'Slow' or 'Loading Zone' markings on the pavement to alert drivers to potential conflicts.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a standard-width sidewalk on the left side of the street to complete the pedestrian network and provide separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Undergrounding Utilities
interventions.description: Relocate utility lines underground to remove poles from the sidewalk, maximizing the clear walking path.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Requirements
interventions.description: Ensure that the permanent development replacing the construction site includes active ground-floor uses and transparent windows to improve safety through eyes on the street.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to complete the pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with high-visibility markings and signage to facilitate safe crossing between the residential and industrial sides.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone to the existing left-side sidewalk to increase separation from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Formalize Parking and Access
interventions.description: Clearly mark parking areas and consolidate driveway access points to reduce conflicts between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route (TPAR)
interventions.description: Ensure construction sites maintain a clear, protected, and accessible path for pedestrians that meets minimum width requirements.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Road Diet
interventions.description: Paint lane lines to organize traffic flow and reduce the perceived width of the road, which can naturally slow down vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Protection
interventions.description: Ensure construction activities maintain a minimum clear width for pedestrians and provide temporary protected walkways if the permanent sidewalk is blocked.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk to provide a safe point for pedestrians to transition between the left-side sidewalk and destinations on the right.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalk to meet modern accessibility standards, potentially by reallocating space from the roadway or parking lane.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles or underground the lines to remove physical barriers from the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a buffer zone with street trees or planters between the sidewalk and the parking lane to improve the pedestrian experience and safety.
